#4273 -- what does the retained `cbuffer cbB` cost downstream?

Produced by `python downstream.py`. rewritten.hlsl in this directory
is step 1's stdout verbatim -- the rewriter's own output, not an
edited copy.

SCOPE: the DXC/SM6 path only. DX11 shaders are built by FXC for
SM5.x, a different compiler, which is NOT tested here.

STEPS

  rewrite    exit 0   <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxr.exe -E vsMain -remove-unused-globals -remove-unused-functions -extract-entry-uniforms repro.hlsl
  compile    exit 0   <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T vs_6_0 -E vsMain rewritten.hlsl -Fc rewritten.dxil.txt
  container  exit 0   <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T vs_6_0 -E vsMain rewritten.hlsl -Qstrip_debug -Fo <cache>/rw4273/rewritten.dxo
  reflect    exit 0   <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxa.exe -dumpreflection <cache>/rw4273/rewritten.dxo

REWRITER OUTPUT (rewritten.hlsl) -- `cbuffer cbB` is present:

  cbuffer cbA {
    const float4 gA;
  }
  ;
  cbuffer cbB {
    const float4 gB;
  }
  ;
  const float4 gLooseUsed;
  float4 vsMain(float4 pos : POSITION) : SV_Position {
    return pos * gA + gLooseUsed;
  }
